in_marathi.name: Satarupa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of Seven
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satarupa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Satarupa is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sat' meaning 'Seven' and 'Rupa' meaning 'Form' or 'Appearance'. In Hindu mythology, Satarupa is considered the mother of the seven rivers. She is also known as Aditi, the goddess of fertility and prosperity.
